body: Most invariants are mechanically decidable with these fixes: (1) 'arbitrary private inputs' is untestable literally; define bounded generative differential traces + audience endpoint/topic/credential allowlists, and static bundle scans. (2-7) property/model tests are decidable once timeout/SLOs are explicit. (8) deletion 'completion' is undecidable if vendors lack receipts; define provider-specific receipt taxonomy, deadline, and a blocking manual-exception state—never infer deletion. (9) currently undecidable: freeze corpus+denominator and threshold before implementation; recommendation gate p95<=5s, timeout=nonpublishable. Keep live public OFF for pilot; if later enabled require >=400 representative/adversarial claims, zero critical false-SUPPORT and Wilson 95% upper bound <1%, plus measured eligible yield. (10) define N/N-1 protocol matrix and SW activation only after session close. Contradictions: stage slide observation should be authoritative for slide position while server remains authoritative for controller/commands; offline Stage may advance locally, then submit current absolute slide on reconnect after deck/version validation—never replay relative commands. Drop the alleged 1-click cross-origin launcher flow from MVP; use the report's two-step Stage click. Define retract accepted->public tombstone p95<=500ms, reconnect snapshot excludes/tombstones revoked IDs, and tombstones retained through card/session TTL.
